name: Valencia Plastics
old_description: 27655 Avenue Hopkins Unit B, Valencia, CA 91355 | Office
about:
Valencia Plastics operates from Valencia, California, where it has provided custom plastic injection and blow molding services for over 20 years. The company runs a full-service facility that includes an in-house mold shop, engineering support, and assembly capabilities.

The shop produces injection-molded parts ranging from 1 gram to 7 lb shot weight and blow-molded parts from 5 grams to 5 lb. It handles multi-component molding such as over molding and insert molding, in-mold labeling, and offers short runs through full-scale production. Standard production lead time is two weeks, with same-day shipping available for stocked items.

Customers span nutritional, nutraceutical, food, pet food, aerospace, agricultural, architectural, construction, consumer goods, dental, electrical, health supplements, marine, automotive, medical, military, oil field, optical, packaging, pharmaceutical, and transportation sectors. The company also works with inventors and new product designers from concept to shelf.

Valencia Plastics emphasizes same-day quotes, samples, and shipping, an in-house CAM-driven mold shop, ISO 9001:2015 and cGMP certifications, and the ability to process up to 100% post-consumer resin using food-grade materials.
